caption: The drawing depicts a single rectangular, shallow container with gently sloping sides and rounded corners, colored in light brown and dark brown hues. The rim of the container is adorned with a row of round, raised decorations, and one of the shorter ends features a flat, protruding handle that extends outward with an arched grip. The interior is darker brown, giving a sense of depth, and the exterior is a lighter, reddish-brown. The background is plain and off-white, with no other objects or features present. The perspective shows the inside and part of the outside of the vessel, emphasizing its three-dimensional form.
title: Earthenware Roasting Pot
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
